# Cloud Threat Hunting Workbook

Interactive hunting workbook aligned to the Cloud Threat Hunting VBD modules. Use the tabs below to investigate specific attack categories.

**Instructions:** Select a time range and optionally scope to a specific user or resource to begin hunting.

content.query:
union withsource=TableName SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, AuditLogs, AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize EventCount = count() by TableName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Event Volume by Source (Overview)
Phishing Indicators

content.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize 
    TokenUseCount = count(),
    DistinctIPs = dcount(IPAddress),
    DistinctResources = dcount(ResourceDisplayName),
    IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 5)
    by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where DistinctIPs > 2
| order by DistinctIPs desc
content.title: Token Replay Indicators (Multi-IP Token Usage)

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationNameValue has 'Microsoft.Logic/workflows'
| summarize Operations = count() by OperationNameValue, Caller, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by Operations desc
content.title: Logic App Operations
Storage & Key Vault Sensitive Operations

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has_any ('service principal credentials', 'federated identity credential', 'app role assignment')
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend Target = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Actor, Target, Result
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Persistence Indicators (SP/MI/Federation Changes)

content.query:
let ExpectedTables = datatable(TableName:string, RequiredForModule:string) [
  'SigninLogs', 'Modules 01, 02',
  'AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs', 'Modules 01, 02, 05',
  'AuditLogs', 'Modules 01, 05',
  'AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs', 'Module 05',
  'AzureActivity', 'Modules 03, 04, 05',
  'StorageBlobLogs', 'Module 04',
  'AzureDiagnostics', 'Modules 03, 04'
];
let ActiveTables = union withsource=T *
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
  | summarize LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated), EventCount = count() by T;
ExpectedTables
| join kind=leftouter (ActiveTables) on $left.TableName == $right.T
| extend Status = iff(isnotempty(LastEvent), '✅ Active', '❌ No Data')
| project TableName, RequiredForModule, Status, LastEvent, EventCount
| order by Status asc, TableName asc
content.title: Log Coverage Assessment
